landing.title: Our Treatments
landing.description: Explore our range of traditional Thai massage and spa treatments in Castle Bromwich, Birmingham. From hot stone massage to herbal compress, find the perfect treatment for you.

tiles.title: Thai Massage & Spa Treatments
tiles.text: Choose from our range of traditional Thai treatments, each one designed to ease tension, restore balance, and leave you feeling genuinely well. Every session is tailored to how you feel on the day.

service1.name: Thai Traditional Massage
service1.tagline: A firm, revitalising massage combining deep pressure, hot oil, and traditional Thai stretching techniques.

service2.name: Hot Stone Massage
service2.tagline: Smooth heated stones melt away deep-seated tension, promoting muscle relaxation and improved circulation.

service3.name: Herbal Compress Massage
service3.tagline: Steamed Thai herbal bundles ease pain, reduce stiffness, and calm inflammation across the body.

service4.name: Thai Relaxing Massage
service4.tagline: A gentle, flowing oil massage with aromatherapy to ease everyday stress and guide you into complete calm.

service5.name: Sport Massage
service5.tagline: Deep-tissue techniques targeting muscle fatigue to speed up recovery and improve physical performance.

service6.name: Body Scrubbing Ritual
service6.tagline: Full-body exfoliation that removes dead skin, stimulates circulation, and reveals smoother, refreshed skin.

service7.name: Facial Massage Therapy
service7.tagline: Releases tension in the face and jaw, boosts circulation, and leaves your complexion naturally refreshed.

packages.title: Spa Packages
packages.text: Choose from our curated packages, each designed to give you the most from your visit.

package1.name: Couples Massage Package
package1.feature1: A full hour of side-by-side massage in a calm, shared space — a lovely way to slow down and reconnect.
package1.feature3: Everything you need for a proper afternoon off together.

package2.name: A Bespoke Blend of Treatments
package2.feature1: A fully personalised wellness experience — choose your preferred combination of massage, facial therapy, and body scrub.
package2.feature2: Tailored to what your body needs most on the day, with guidance from our team.
package2.feature3: No two sessions are the same, and that's exactly the point.

package3.name: The Lotus Wellness Journey
package3.feature1: A three-hour journey through our finest treatments, including facial therapy and our signature massage.
package3.feature2: Each stage flows naturally into the next, giving your body time to fully unwind at every step.
package3.feature3: Our most complete wellness experience, and one you'll want to return to.
